title: Seswaa
description: Seswaa is a Botswana dish made with beef chuck, yellow onion, bay leaf, parsley. This home-scale recipe assigns measured ingredients to the steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Pat the main ingredients dry. Brown in a hot heavy pan in batches for about 12 minutes, turning to color all sides.
Add the braising liquid and seasonings, cover and cook gently for about 175 minutes until the meat is tender and safely cooked.
Drain the cooked ingredients and pound or mash while warm for about 12 minutes until thick, elastic and smooth; shape into portions with wet hands or a spoon.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
